# RKO scope. Adds temp variable wif_rko_germ_delta (scripted effects take no
# parameters):  set_temp_variable = { wif_rko_germ_delta = 5 } wif_rko_germ_add = yes
# Every point gained feeds the Forest Brothers' grievance (0.02 a point; x2 strict, x0.5 lenient).
wif_rko_germ_add = {
	add_to_variable = { wif_rko_germ = wif_rko_germ_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rko_germ min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rko_g = wif_rko_germ_delta }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rko_g = 0.02 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_strict } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rko_g = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_lenient } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rko_g = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rko_g > 0 } } add_to_variable = { wif_rko_fs_grief = wif_rko_g } }
	wif_rko_germ_refresh = yes
}

		clamp_variable = { var = wif_rko_fs min = 10 max = 100 }

		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rko_chance = 0.5 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_informers } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rko_chance = 0.85 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rko_fs > 89.9 } } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rko_chance = 1.5 } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rko_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_rko_roll < wif_rko_chance } }
			wif_rko_fs_attack = yes
		}
	}
}

# State scope, ROOT = RKO: the railway or a factory.
wif_rko_raid_damage = {
	random_list = {
		40 = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 2 } }
		30 = {
			if = { limit = { industrial_complex > 0 } damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = 1 } }
			else = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 } }
		}
		30 = {
			if = { limit = { arms_factory > 0 } damage_building = { type = arms_factory damage = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { industrial_complex > 0 } damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = 1 } }
			else = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

# FBR scope, daily while Ostland stands: one half-equipped militia per state taken from it.

	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_partisan NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_rko_fallen } }

			limit = { is_owned_by = RKO is_controlled_by = FBR NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_fbr_militia_raised } }

			create_unit = { division = "division_template = \"Forest Brothers Militia\" start_experience_factor = 0.05 start_equipment_factor = 0.5" owner = FBR count = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	}
	811 = { create_unit = { division = "division_template = \"Estonian Liberation Infantry\" start_experience_factor = 0.2 start_equipment_factor = 1.0" owner = EST count = 3 } }
	news_event = { id = wif_rko.50 days = 1 }
}

# RKO scope (it has just capitulated): the partisans take the Ostland.
wif_rko_falls = {
	set_global_flag = wif_rko_fallen
	if = { limit = { country_exists = FBR } FBR = { delete_unit = { division_template = "Forest Brothers Militia" } } }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = EST EST = { has_country_flag = wif_elf } 812 = { is_owned_by = RKO } }
		812 = { transfer_state_to = EST }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = RKO }
		if = {
			limit = { controller = { tag = SME } }
			transfer_state_to = SME
		}
		# Belarus only ever gets Belarusian land: Latgale (or any Baltic state) it holds goes to the Brothers.
		else_if = {
			limit = { controller = { tag = BLR } NOT = { OR = { state = 206 state = 204 state = 194 state = 94 state = 95 state = 96 } } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = FBR } transfer_state_to = FBR }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { controller = { wif_is_rko_partisan = yes } }
			CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = wif_rko_taker }
			transfer_state_to = event_target:wif_rko_taker
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 13 state = 191 state = 813 state = 812 state = 811 state = 808 state = 190 state = 809 state = 12 state = 810 state = 11 state = 189 state = 814 state = 815 state = 784 } country_exists = FBR }
			transfer_state_to = FBR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 206 state = 204 state = 194 state = 94 state = 95 state = 96 } country_exists = BLR }
			transfer_state_to = BLR
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = FBR }
		FBR = { set_cosmetic_tag = FBR_wif_baltic_union }
		13 = { add_core_of = FBR } 191 = { add_core_of = FBR } 813 = { add_core_of = FBR } 812 = { add_core_of = FBR } 811 = { add_core_of = FBR } 808 = { add_core_of = FBR } 190 = { add_core_of = FBR } 809 = { add_core_of = FBR } 12 = { add_core_of = FBR } 810 = { add_core_of = FBR } 11 = { add_core_of = FBR } 189 = { add_core_of = FBR } 814 = { add_core_of = FBR } 815 = { add_core_of = FBR } 784 = { add_core_of = FBR }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = EST EST = { has_country_flag = wif_elf } country_exists = SWE }
		EST = { set_country_flag = wif_elf_swedish remove_ideas = wif_splinter_no_factions }
		SWE = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { EST = { is_subject_of = SWE } } } puppet = EST }
			set_autonomy = { target = EST autonomy_state = autonomy_supervised_state end_wars = no end_civil_wars = no }
		}
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rko.41 days = 1 }
}

# Global: re-establish Reichskommissariat Ostland under the Reich (after transfer_state_to RKO).
wif_rko_reestablish_puppet = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = RKO country_exists = GER }
		GER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { RKO = { is_subject_of = GER } } } puppet = RKO }
			set_autonomy = { target = RKO autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat end_wars = no end_civil_wars = no }
		}
		RKO = { country_event = { id = wif_rko.45 days = 1 } }
	}
}

# Partisan scope (capitulated to the reunited Reich): its land goes back to Ostland.
wif_rko_reestablish = {
	every_owned_state = { transfer_state_to = RKO }
	wif_rko_reestablish_puppet = yes
}

# on_capitulation_immediate: ROOT capitulated, FROM the winner.
wif_rko_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = RKO has_global_flag = wif_rko_uprising NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_rko_fallen } any_country = { wif_is_rko_partisan = yes } }
		wif_rko_falls = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = EST has_country_flag = wif_elf_swedish has_war_with = GER }
		# Swedish Estonia has fallen: the war with Sweden ends and the land goes back.
		every_owned_state = { transfer_state_to = RKO }
		wif_rko_reestablish_puppet = yes
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SWE GER = { has_war_with = SWE } } GER = { white_peace = SWE } }
		news_event = { id = wif_rko.62 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { wif_is_rko_partisan = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_elf_swedish } FROM = { tag = GER } has_global_flag = wif_ger_reunified }
		wif_rko_reestablish = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { wif_is_rko_partisan = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_elf_swedish } FROM = { tag = RKO } }
		RKO = { annex_country = { target = ROOT transfer_troops = yes } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war OR = { tag = RKO tag = RKU } }
		wif_sme_revenge_check = yes
	}
}

# RKO scope, daily.
wif_rko_daily = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_setup } } wif_rko_setup = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rko_terror_days > 0 } any_owned_state = { OR = { state = 206 state = 204 state = 194 state = 94 state = 95 state = 96 state = 810 } } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rko_terror_days = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rko_terror_days > 0 } } } country_event = { id = wif_rko.20 hours = 6 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_rko_uprising }
			has_global_flag = wif_sme_war_active
			OR = {
				195 = { controller = { tag = SME } }
				247 = { controller = { tag = SME } }
			}
		}
		wif_rko_uprising = yes
	}
	# The Ostschild forms: the bonuses of First Among the Reichskommissariate and Ostschild Command.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_sme_war_pending NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_ostschild_bonus } }
		set_country_flag = wif_rko_ostschild_bonus
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_first_among }
			add_political_power = 100
			every_country = { limit = { OR = { tag = RKO tag = RKU tag = RKM tag = RKK } } add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rko_ostschild_org_idea days = 730 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rko_ostschild_command }
			every_country = { limit = { OR = { tag = RKO tag = RKU tag = RKM tag = RKK } } add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rko_ostschild_def_idea days = 365 } }
		}
	}
}

wif_rko_monthly = {
	wif_rko_germ_monthly = yes
	wif_rko_fs_monthly = yes
	wif_rko_compliance_cap = yes
	wif_rko_depop_step = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Reich returns
# GER scope, weekly.
wif_rko_ger_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_ger_reunified }
		# War on every Ostland partisan but Sweden's Estonia.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_rko_uprising }
			every_country = {
				limit = { wif_is_rko_partisan = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_elf_swedish } NOT = { has_war_with = GER } }
				save_event_target_as = wif_rko_target
				GER = { declare_war_on = { target = event_target:wif_rko_target type = annex_everything } }
			}
		}
		# Sweden's Estonia: the ultimatum, once.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_rko_fallen
				NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_elf_ultimatum }
				country_exists = EST EST = { has_country_flag = wif_elf_swedish is_subject_of = SWE }
				country_exists = SWE
			}
			set_global_flag = wif_elf_ultimatum
			SWE = { country_event = { id = wif_rko.60 days = 1 } }
		}
		# The war of revenge.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_sme_war_won
				NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_done }
				country_exists = SME
				country_exists = RKO RKO = { is_subject_of = GER }
				country_exists = RKU RKU = { is_subject_of = GER }
				NOT = { any_country = { OR = { wif_is_rko_partisan = yes wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } has_war_with = GER NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_elf_swedish } } }
				NOT = { has_war_with = SME }
			}
			wif_sme_revenge_start = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war }
			wif_sme_revenge_check = yes
		}
	}
}

# GER scope.
wif_sme_revenge_start = {
	set_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war
	declare_war_on = { target = SME type = annex_everything }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { tag = RKO tag = RKU } is_subject_of = GER NOT = { has_war_with = SME } }
		declare_war_on = { target = SME type = annex_everything }
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rko.70 days = 1 }
}

# Any scope.
wif_sme_revenge_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war
			219 = { controller = { OR = { tag = GER is_subject_of = GER } } }
		}
		wif_sme_revenge_won = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war
			OR = { NOT = { country_exists = RKO } RKO = { has_capitulated = yes } }
			OR = { NOT = { country_exists = RKU } RKU = { has_capitulated = yes } }
		}
		wif_sme_revenge_lost = yes
	}
}

# Moscow is German again: Moskowien and Kaukasien are re-established, and peace.
wif_sme_revenge_won = {
	clr_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war
	set_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_done
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { is_owned_by = SME is_owned_by = GER } GER_is_RKM_state = yes }
		transfer_state_to = RKM
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { is_owned_by = SME is_owned_by = GER } GER_is_RKK_state = yes }
		transfer_state_to = RKK
	}
	GER = {
		if = { limit = { country_exists = RKM } if = { limit = { NOT = { RKM = { is_subject_of = GER } } } puppet = RKM } set_autonomy = { target = RKM autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat end_wars = no end_civil_wars = no } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = RKK } if = { limit = { NOT = { RKK = { is_subject_of = GER } } } puppet = RKK } set_autonomy = { target = RKK autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat end_wars = no end_civil_wars = no } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SME }
		# The rest of the SME's land the Reich holds, it keeps - as in the first war's defeat.
		SME = {
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { controller = { has_war_with = SME OR = { tag = GER is_subject_of = GER } } }
				CONTROLLER = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_war_with = SME OR = { tag = GER is_subject_of = GER } }
			white_peace = SME
		}
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rko.71 days = 1 }
	# Beaten a second time, the SME falls apart (zz_wif_sme_c_war.txt).
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SME NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_sme_collapsing } }
		set_global_flag = wif_sme_war_lost
		SME = { set_country_flag = wif_sme_war_lost }
		wif_sme_collapse_begin = yes
	}
}

# Ostland and Ukraine have both fallen: the SME takes them too, and the Reich makes peace.
wif_sme_revenge_lost = {
	clr_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_war
	set_global_flag = wif_sme_revenge_done
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SME }
		SME = {
			if = { limit = { country_exists = RKO } annex_country = { target = RKO transfer_troops = yes } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = RKU } annex_country = { target = RKU transfer_troops = yes } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_war_with = SME OR = { tag = GER is_subject_of = GER } }
			white_peace = SME
		}
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rko.72 days = 1 }
}
